mapper.select: SELECT id, warehouse_id, material_id, type, quantity, purchase_request_id, project_id, operator_id, created_at FROM t_stock_record WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_stock_record (warehouse_id, material_id, type, quantity, purchase_request_id, project_id, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{materialId}, #{type}, #{quantity}, #{purchaseRequestId}, #{projectId}, #{operatorId}, NOW())
